Messages.Author: Abrouse
Messages.Body:
This card said, in this combat in a given round any additional damage inflict successfully is prevented. If I used this effect in this card in the first round of a combat and the oppossit minion pres to continue the combat. In the second round the effect of Flesh of Marble still valid?
Remember: In the first round I used this card to prevent the additional damege!

Messages.Author: DavidR
Messages.Body:
Each round you will take one damage and prevent all other damage, note that if this lone damage was aggravated you still go to torpor

David Resende - Prince of Teresina
